senses.gloss:
खेद, अस्, m. lassitude, depression; exhaustion;
pain; poverty; sorrow, affliction, distress; (आ), f.,
Ved. a hammer, mallet or similar implement be-
longing to Indra.
—खेदान्वित (˚द-अन्˚), अस्, आ,
अम्, distressed, pained.
खेद खेद. See under rt. खिद्.

खेदन, अम्, n. lassitude, exhaustion, pain, sor-
row, affliction, poverty, distress.

खेदयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be depressed, to be
made distressed.

खेदित, अस्, आ, अम्, disturbed, annoyed, harassed;
afflicted, distressed, pained.

खेदितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be depressed or cast
down, to be troubled.
खेदि खेदि, अयस्, m. pl., Ved. rays (?).
